prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the long reflecting pool path in front of the Taj Mahal with pale marble paving, a waist-high ornamental rail and low steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as him, NO dark background NO black void, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean man in his early 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, metallic gold glitter eyeshadow with defined lashes, smooth fair skin with a warm undertone, composed and elegant, bold vivid tangerine-orange hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a single silver earring. Long stiletto nails, holographic finish.
Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: His bare skin is painted in Spanish Talavera de la Reina ceramic (a warm ivory ground with cobalt-blue and ochre floral medallions), wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense floral medallion border filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every muscle and bulge. The paint covers his whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of his hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of his feet. His face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera.
Footwear: Extreme silver platform stiletto heels, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the muscle and flesh fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: the painted pattern catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every muscle and fold.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
